     6|module
     7|
     8|public import Mathlib.Order.Filter.AtTopBot.Defs
     9|public import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.Disjoint
    10|
    11|/-!
    12|# Disjointness of `Filter.atTop` and `Filter.atBot`
    13|-/
    14|
    15|public section
    16|
    17|assert_not_exists Finset
    18|
    19|variable {ι ι' α β γ : Type*}
    20|
    21|open Set
    22|
    23|namespace Filter
    24|
    25|@[to_dual disjoint_atTop_principal_Iio]
    26|theorem disjoint_atBot_principal_Ioi [Preorder α] (x : α) : Disjoint atBot (𝓟 (Ioi x)) :=
    27|  disjoint_of_disjoint_of_mem (Iic_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl) (Iic_mem_atBot x) (mem_principal_self _)
    28|
    29|@[to_dual disjoint_atBot_principal_Ici]
    30|theorem disjoint_atTop_principal_Iic [Preorder α] [NoTopOrder α] (x : α) :
    31|    Disjoint atTop (𝓟 (Iic x)) :=
    32|  disjoint_of_disjoint_of_mem (Iic_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl).symm (Ioi_mem_atTop x)
    33|    (mem_principal_self _)
    34|
    35|@[to_dual disjoint_pure_atBot]
    36|theorem disjoint_pure_atTop [Preorder α] [NoTopOrder α] (x : α) : Disjoint (pure x) atTop :=
    37|  Disjoint.symm <| (disjoint_atTop_principal_Iic x).mono_right <| le_principal_iff.2 <|
    38|    mem_pure.2 self_mem_Iic
    39|
    40|@[to_dual disjoint_atTop_atBot]
    41|theorem disjoint_atBot_atTop [PartialOrder α] [Nontrivial α] :
    42|    Disjoint (atBot : Filter α) atTop := by
    43|  rcases exists_pair_ne α with ⟨x, y, hne⟩
    44|  by_cases hle : x ≤ y
    45|  · refine disjoint_of_disjoint_of_mem ?_ (Iic_mem_atBot x) (Ici_mem_atTop y)
    46|    exact Iic_disjoint_Ici.2 (hle.lt_of_ne hne).not_ge
    47|  · refine disjoint_of_disjoint_of_mem ?_ (Iic_mem_atBot y) (Ici_mem_atTop x)
    48|    exact Iic_disjoint_Ici.2 hle
    49|
    50|end Filter
